engine_vs_scorer._doc: Sealed holdout v2 (158 slides) rendered by the v1.3.3 engine (a2f4dbc) and the v1.4 engine (430176d), each scored by the v1.3.3 scorer (frozen before v1.4) and the v1.4 scorer. Separates engine improvement from metric/profile change. Values: slide mean / macro archetype / P10.
engine_vs_scorer.reading: Under the frozen v1.3.3 scorer the engine change alone moves the mean +9.8, macro +8.8, P10 +17.1. The rest of the v1.4 score (P10 53.6 → 73.7) comes from the provisional profile changes for process, comparison and kpi_dashboard, which only human votes (round r2) can validate.

findings_for_v1.5: kpi_dashboard is the weakest archetype (71.6, n=5, NOT HEALTHY provisional); one dashboard slide has a hard LOW_CONTRAST error (likely a coloured delta on the v1.4 KPI card fill)
PROOF_NOT_VISIBLE causes 7 of the 8 slides below 62: derived headline numbers (sums, differences, ratios) are still not recognised as proven
OUTSIDE_ZONE ×2 on a Spanish waterfall; RENDER_TEXT_SPILL on a long statement

r2.method: Preference = challenger wins / decisive votes, Wilson 95% interval (ties excluded; ties-as-half also shown). Agreement: percent agreement and Fleiss' kappa over {baseline, challenger, tie} on pairs rated by ≥2 evaluators. Human preference is an independent signal and is never part of the automatic composition score.
